method: Built-in image_gen tool, sequential edits using prior sock previews and the adult front-on-feet reference
notes: Eight active Ecommerce templates. Original filename numbers are retained; UI numbers them consecutively.
Shaped socks now show actual adult lower legs above the cuffs. Flat Lay, Knit Texture, Front on Feet and Folded Product retain their existing images.
All original and superseded source images remain archived in this folder, outside public serving.

outputs.title: Three-Quarter on Feet
outputs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / product-mockup. Create ONE photorealistic ecommerce photograph revising the supplied sock preview. Preserve the same unbranded warm ivory/cream crew socks, narrow regular rib knit, smooth same-colour heel and rounded toe, yarn texture, correct natural fabric thickness. Keep neutral warm light-grey seamless backdrop, soft studio lighting, portrait 4:5 format. Important user requirement: whenever a sock has a filled-out shape, it must visibly be worn on a real adult foot and lower leg. Show a substantial strip of natural calf skin ABOVE each sock cuff, with the leg continuing out of the top edge; absolutely no hollow openings, amputated/standalone socks, invisible fill, floating socks, shoes, captions, graphics or watermark. Adult only, crop below the knees and omit face/torso. Use the supporting front-on-feet image for matching warm medium skin tone, realistic anatomy, cuff height and fit. A single finished photograph. Revise original output01 into THREE-QUARTER ON FEET. Image1 is the original three-quarter sock pair composition. Image2 is the established adult model wearing these socks. Photograph both socked feet at a three-quarter angle, turned approximately35 degrees toward the left, showing rounded toes, ribbed insteps, outside foot shape and the heels. Both feet comfortably flat on the floor in a natural slightly staggered stance; no high tiptoe pose. Show both full socks and their cuffs, with a generous visible section of actual bare adult calf above each cuff continuing out the upper frame. Frame roughly just below knees to floor, all toes and heels included with margins. Match model, fit and realistic foot dimensions to image2; choose this same photographic angle as image1 while adding visible legs. Keep pair clearly distinct from a head-on front view.
